cost.description: Cost in credits for this request
cost.title: Cost

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Under `auto` a ratio the prompt asks for wins, otherwise the output keeps the first reference image's framing; without references the prompt decides, else 1:1.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

grounding.description: When true (default) the prompt may be grounded in external research: web search and image search. When false, both are off.
grounding.title: Grounding

images.description: Optional reference image(s) the prompt edits or draws from; each is an http(s) URL or base64, one to 10 total.
images.title: Images

resolution.description: Image resolution class, an equal-pixel-area tier: `768sq`, `1k`, `1.5k`, `2k`, or `4k`. Exact dimensions vary with the aspect ratio.
resolution.title: Resolution

safety_tolerance.description: Harm moderation tolerance from 0 to 7, with 0 the strictest. The route and organization determine the approved maximum and per-category ceilings. Unapproved levels return 422 with approved levels.
safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance

version.description: Endpoint version. `latest` (default) serves the current release; dated pinnable release tags are added here as they are published.
version.title: Version

cost.description: Settled cost in credits for this request
cost.title: Cost

method: unauthenticated GETs of public documentation; no API key used, no billable call

quotes.flux2_limit: Reference multiple images simultaneously - up to 8 via API, up to 10 in the playground.
quotes.flux3_503: A failed task can come back as HTTP 503 with a normal JSON body. Read `status` from the body before treating a 503 as a retryable outage.
quotes.flux3_ready: A `Ready` result also includes `result.prompt`, the expanded prompt the model used, and `result.duration`, the generation time in seconds.
quotes.flux3_ref_limits: 400: A reference image is larger than 16 megapixels; 422: an image smaller than 256 x 256
quotes.flux3_submit: The submit response returns immediately with `id`, `polling_url`, `cost`, `input_mp`, and `output_mp`.
quotes.flux3_unknown_fields: fields from other endpoints, such as `seed`, `width`, and `input_image`, don't work here (422)
quotes.flux3_url_expiry: The signed URL in `result.sample` expires after **1 hour**. (flux3_image_generate)
quotes.integration_url_expiry: 10-Minute Expiration: Generated images expire after 10 minutes and become inaccessible. (integration_guidelines)
quotes.pricing_flux3: FLUX 3 Image is priced per image by `resolution` ... The submission response includes the `cost` of each request.
quotes.rate_limit: Maximum 24 concurrent requests for most endpoints

sources.pricing_feed: https://2gpum2i6.api.sanity.io/v2025-02-19/data/query/production (the query the pricing page itself runs; values in US cents)
